cases.sentence: Пусть они расположатся у ___, прямо перед Баал-Цифоном.
cases.translation: Let them encamp by the sea, right before Baal Zephon.
cases.explain: The preposition у governs the genitive case.

cases.translation: I will get glory, defeating Pharaoh with his army.
cases.explain: The preposition с in the sense of 'together with' governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Они очень испугались и стали взывать ___.
cases.translation: They were very afraid and began to cry out to the Lord.
cases.explain: The verb взывать (to cry out to someone) takes its addressee in the dative case.

cases.sentence: Разве в Египте не было могил, что ты повел нас умирать в ___?
cases.translation: Were there no graves in Egypt, that you led us out to die in the wilderness?
cases.explain: The preposition в expressing motion into takes the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Лучше бы нам оставаться рабами, чем умирать в ___.
cases.translation: It would be better for us to remain slaves than to die in the wilderness.
cases.explain: The preposition в indicating location takes the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Господь всю ночь отгонял море сильным восточным ___.
cases.translation: All night the Lord drove the sea back with a strong east wind.
cases.explain: The instrumental case expresses the means (by a strong wind).

cases.sentence: Господь посмотрел из огненного и облачного ___ на египетское войско.
cases.translation: The Lord looked out on the Egyptian army from the pillar of fire and cloud.
cases.explain: The preposition из governs the genitive case.

cases.translation: Israel saw them dead on the shore.
cases.explain: The preposition на indicating location takes the prepositional (locative) case.

reading.ru: Он взял 600 отборных колесниц и все остальные колесницы Египта с их начальниками.
reading.question: How many chosen chariots did Pharaoh take?
reading.explain: The text says 'Он взял 600 отборных колесниц' (he took 600 chosen chariots).

reading.ru: Они очень испугались и стали взывать Господу.
reading.question: How did the Israelites react when they saw the Egyptians pursuing?
options: They were very afraid and cried out to the Lord
reading.correct: They were very afraid and cried out to the Lord
reading.explain: The text says they 'очень испугались и стали взывать Господу' (were very afraid and cried out to the Lord).

reading.ru: Моисей простер руку над морем, а Господь всю ночь отгонял море сильным восточным ветром и превратил его в сушу.
reading.question: How did the Lord turn the sea into dry land?
options: By a strong east wind all night
reading.correct: By a strong east wind all night
reading.explain: The text says the Lord drove the sea back 'сильным восточным ветром' (by a strong east wind) all night.

reading.question: What happened to Pharaoh's army in the sea?
options: Not one of them was saved
reading.correct: Not one of them was saved
reading.explain: The text says 'Не спасся никто' (no one was saved).

reading.ru: В тот день Господь спас Израиль от египтян, и Израиль увидел их мертвыми на берегу.
reading.question: What did Israel see on the shore that day?
reading.explain: The text says Israel 'увидел их мертвыми на берегу' (saw them dead on the shore).

reading.question: What did the Egyptians say when their army was thrown into confusion?
reading.explain: The text says the Egyptians said 'Бежим отсюда' (let us flee from here).
